title: Coherent classifying-diagram comparison from a fibre-localizing cocartesian map
statement:
Use ordinary nerves, quasicategories, coherent functor categories and universes of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], cocartesian straightening and $\operatorname{Cat}_\infty$ of [lem-coef-cocartesian-straightening], and systems of arrows, $\mathsf{WCat}_\infty$ and its localization adjunction $L\dashv G$ of [lem-coef-system-localization-universal]. Let $C$ be a small ordinary category and $H:C\to\operatorname{Cat}$ a strict diagram of small ordinary categories. For every $c$, let $W_c$ be a wide subcategory of $H(c)$ containing all isomorphisms, and assume every transition $f_!=H(f)$ preserves $W$. Define $T$ to have objects $(c,x)$, arrows $(c,x)\to(d,y)$ given by pairs $(f,v)$ with $f:c\to d$ and $v:f_!x\to y$, and composition $(g,w)(f,v)=(gf,w\circ g_!v)$. Write $\bar f_x=(f,1):(c,x)\to(d,f_!x)$ for its chosen ordinary cocartesian lifts. Let $p:\mathcal P\to NC$ be an intrinsic cocartesian fibration, and let $q:NT\to\mathcal P$ be a coherent functor over $NC$ which carries every $\bar f_x$ to a $p$-cocartesian edge. For each $c$ let $\lambda_c:NH(c)\to H(c)[W_c^{-1}]_\infty$ be the localization unit. Suppose the fibre restriction $q_c:NH(c)\to\mathcal P_c$ has a specified factorization $q_c\simeq J_c\lambda_c$ with $J_c:H(c)[W_c^{-1}]_\infty\to\mathcal P_c$ an equivalence. No localization property is assumed for the functor $q$ on total categories.

Let $H_\infty:NC\to\operatorname{Cat}_\infty$ be $L$ applied to the relative diagram $c\mapsto(NH(c),W_c)$. There is a coherent natural equivalence
$$\overline\theta:H_\infty\xrightarrow{\simeq}\operatorname{St}_{NC}(p)$$
whose component at $c$ is $J_c$ and whose composite with the pointwise localization unit is the transformation obtained from $q$ by straightening. In particular the nerve $NT\to NC$ is the cocartesian family classified by $NH$, and $q$ induces that transformation before localization. The equivalence $\overline\theta$ identifies transport with localized $f_!$, including all compositional and higher naturality coherences, and unstraightening it gives an equivalence $\int_C H_\infty\simeq\mathcal P$ over $NC$ identifying the specified fibre functors. These constructions are natural in the displayed diagrams and functors, with contractible choices once the factorization and classification data are retained. All categories and functor categories are formed in containing universes in which their shapes and values are small.
